_comment: Lines for who you were before the fall (flag origin_<id>) and for a run that remembers an earlier ending (flag echo, echo_<ending>).

lines.text: You count with your lips moving. Courier habit. I'll be watching that. Fondly. Mostly fondly.
Forty runs a season on the surface, you said. With nothing to carry it in but a coat. I have nine pockets in this apron and I still lose pencils.
Page forty-one of the ledger is in my handwriting, and I haven't written it yet. I am choosing not to think about that.
